2609.26016.title: Compiling Sufficient Governance Context from Declared Losses and Reachable States: Exact Observation-Contract Synthesis with Cardinality and Cost Objectives
2609.26016.paper_summary: We call the object this paper derives and certifies a minimal sufficient governance context: given a finite reachable-state model, a deterministic declared verdict, and candidate observable attributes, we compute sufficient observation sets, distinguish attributes that are individually indispensable from contracts that are jointly sufficient, and select among sufficient contracts under a cardinality or declared-cost objective. An observation contract is a set of candidate attributes whose values determine the declared verdict on every reachable state; an authority contract is one selected under an objective and bound to a gate schema. We synthesize every inclusion-minimal sufficient contract where exhaustive enumeration is affordable, and a minimum-cardinality or minimum-cost contract by SAT/MaxSAT encoding otherwise, checking sufficiency directly. On a constructed code/cloud domain, the individually-indispensable core is not sufficient as an observation contract and two distinct reducts exist; a preregistered cost model separates them exactly. On a second, larger, constructed domain, the same pattern recurs, but that domain's cost model does not separate the alternatives: a fully explained cost tie, reported as found. We measure discernibility-family scaling where exhaustive enumeration is confirmed infeasible within a registered timeout, while SAT/MaxSAT synthesis solves in well under a second; MaxSAT showed no measured cardinality advantage over plain SAT. AuthorityBench compares four baselines across three domains; the declared-only baseline is not exactly sufficient on any. Every selected contract is checked for sufficiency, with a counterexample on failure and a check summary, not a portable certificate, on success -- the compiler-focused scope of a two-scope table; an independently specified end-to-end case study is registered follow-up work, not claimed here.
2609.26016.paper_summary_zh: 我們稱這篇論文所推導和證明的對象為最小充分治理背景：給定一個有限可達狀態模型、一個確定性聲明的判決，以及候選可觀察屬性，我們計算充分觀察集，區分個別不可或缺的屬性與共同充分的合約，並在基數或聲明成本目標下選擇充分合約。觀察合約是一組候選屬性，其值決定每個可達狀態上的聲明判決；權威合約是在一個目標下選擇並綁定於一個閘門架構的合約。我們合成每個包含最小的充分合約，當全面列舉是可負擔的情況下，否則通過SAT/MaxSAT編碼合成最小基數或最小成本合約，並直接檢查充分性。在一個構建的代碼/雲域中，個別不可或缺的核心作為觀察合約並不充分，且存在兩個不同的簡約；一個預註冊的成本模型恰好將它們分開。在第二個更大構建的域中，相同的模式重現，但該域的成本模型並未分開這些選擇：完全解釋的成本平局，如實報告。我們測量可辨識性家族的擴展性，其中全面列舉在註冊的超時內被確認為不可行，而SAT/MaxSAT合成在不到一秒內解決；MaxSAT在測量的基數上未顯示出相對於普通SAT的優勢。AuthorityBench在三個域中比較四個基準；僅聲明基準在任何情況下都不完全充分。每個選定的合約都檢查其充分性，失敗時提供反例，成功時提供檢查摘要，而不是可攜帶的證書——一個以編譯器為中心的兩範疇表的範圍；一個獨立指定的端到端案例研究被註冊為後續工作，並未在此聲明。
2609.26016.author: Gaston Besanson et.al.
